plan.p0: Plausible mechanism: detect every complete monochromatic rectangular frame and recolor all cells strictly inside it to 7, leaving the frame and exterior unchanged. Distinguishing assumption: any frame color and any rectangular size qualifies.
plan.p1: Plausible mechanism: identify enclosed regions whose interior is background color 1, then replace those interior cells with 7. Distinguishing assumption: enclosure alone is insufficient; holes containing another background color would remain unchanged.
plan.p2: Plausible mechanism: fill only enclosed square holes of odd side length with 7, as in the observed 3×3 and 5×5 frames. Distinguishing assumption: non-square or even-sized rectangular interiors would not be filled.
plan.p3: Plausible mechanism: recolor every bounded background connected component surrounded by non-background cells to 7, regardless of whether its boundary is a perfect rectangle. Distinguishing assumption: irregular closed boundaries qualify, unlike a strict rectangular-frame rule.
